attributes.name: Jamirah
attributes.powers:
Jamirah is immune to the Mental trait.

Before you act, succeed at a Strength or Melee 8 check or Jamirah is evaded.

After you act, if the result or your check to defeat is less than 22, each character at this location may draw a card.
